text:
mike: quick sync — we need a dashboard that shows latency by region and a view for cross-region failover impact + traffic split. p50/p95/p99, requests/s, and error rates. who can pull runtime inputs? :eyes:

anika: I can own runtime metrics export. need to confirm which tags we have on RPCs today (origin_region, target_zone, model_variant?).

lee: console team can wire up panels once we have metric names and label sets. prefer a small number of canonical metrics rather than lots of ad-hoc ones.

jordan: +1. also want to see routing_decision and fallback_reason for failed/fallbacked requests (e.g., capacity, quota, latency_threshold). helps correlate increased latency with cross-region ramps.

mike: right — minimum set proposal from product: request_count, success_count, error_count, request_latency_histogram, routing_decision_count, traffic_split_ratio. label by origin_region, target_region/zone, model_variant, route_id, customer_tier.

anika: runtime currently emits request_latency (histogram) with labels: target_zone, model_id, env. we can add origin_region and routing_decision, but it will require a small API bump in the agent (one extra label).

lee: what's the impact on metrics cardinality? origin_region + target_zone + model_variant + route_id could explode. we should limit route_id cardinality (use route_group) and model_variant to top-5, rollup rest.

anika: agreed. plan: add origin_region and routing_decision as labels; map route_id -> route_group in the exporter; add model_variant but only when variant != "default". falls back to "default" label otherwise.

jordan: for failover impact we need a timeline view: before/after failover — show traffic_split_ratio (origin_region -> target_region percent), p95 latency by target_region, and error_rate. also add a chart for retry_rate and quota_rejections.

mike: can you sketch the PromQL queries for the console team? they like copy/paste.

anika: example p95 by origin region (histogram):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, origin_region))
```
p95 by target_zone:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, target_zone))
```
traffic split % from origin -> target (5m):
```
sum(rate(request_count{routing_decision!="fallback"} [5m])) by (origin_region, target_region)
/ sum(rate(request_count[5m])) by (origin_region)
```

lee: perfect. we'll need a derived panel for failover: compute delta in traffic_split and a heatmap for latency delta. keep the panel config paramized for time windows.

jordan: also surface a lightweight sampling trace id header when routing_decision == "cross_region_failover" so SREs can grab traces. maybe add sample_rate label to routing_decision_count.

anika: ok will add routing_sampled boolean and trace_id header passthrough when sampled. need to coordinate with runtime team for sampling budget.

mike: action items: anika to PR exporter label changes + docs (ETA 2d). lee to create console panel templates (ETA 3d) and share JSON. jordan to draft SLO adjustments for cross-region tail. i'll coordinate rollout UX changes to show active failover overlays in the console.

infra-bot: scheduled: exporter-labels PR opened by anika — https://git.internal/r/redwood/exporter/merge/1234 (CI pending). :robot_face:

lee: will mock the panels with fake data and share tomorrow. can we add an "impact" banner in the console UI when cross-region traffic >10% for >1min?

mike: yes, that would be super helpful — add a small design note in the panel ticket.

jordan: one more thing — quota-induced fallbacks tend to spike latency upstream due to retries. include quota_rejection_count and retries_count as first-class metrics.

anika: adding quota_rejection_count label by origin_region/route_group. retries_count already exists but not labeled by origin_region; will add that.

mike: nice. thanks all. will capture these in the rollout checklist and ping infra owners once PR merges. :thumbsup:
